description: Emotional direction for the beat. Each mood carries a tint used by the UI glow and the exported share image, plus a short production note so the mood is actionable instead of decorative.

items.name: Dark
items.note: Low register, few notes, lots of shadow.

items.name: Melancholic
items.note: Minor, but never dramatic. Restrained.

items.name: Dreamy
items.note: Blur the transients. Nothing should feel urgent.

items.name: Cold
items.note: Thin highs, dry space, no warmth in the mix.

items.name: Night Drive
items.note: Steady motion. Something moving under the pad.

items.name: Sunny
items.note: Major key, open highs, relaxed pocket.

items.name: Dusty
items.note: Roll off above 8k. Let the noise floor breathe.

items.name: Warm
items.note: Saturate the mids. Keep the low end round.

items.name: Sad
items.note: One idea, repeated, slightly out of tune.

items.name: Aggressive
items.note: Push the drums past comfortable.

items.name: Calm
items.note: No sudden events. Long tails.

items.name: Cinematic
items.note: Think in scenes. Give it a beginning.

items.name: Spiritual
items.note: Voices, space, and patience.

items.name: Epic
items.note: Earn the payoff. Hold it back first.

items.name: Minimal
items.note: Remove until it almost breaks.

items.name: Vintage
items.note: Tape, wow and flutter, mono-ish image.

items.name: Broken
items.note: Something should feel structurally wrong.

items.name: Hopeful
items.note: Resolve upward. Let the chord land.

items.name: Chaotic
items.note: Too many events. Do not clean it up.

items.name: Rainy Night
items.note: Add space and a little noise. Slow the attack.

items.name: Nostalgic
items.note: Make it sound remembered, not recorded.

items.name: Hazy
items.note: Detune slightly. Blur the stereo field.

items.name: Euphoric
items.note: Lift everything at the same moment.

items.name: Paranoid
items.note: One element that never quite settles.

items.name: Triumphant
items.note: Big, but keep the low end controlled.

items.name: Lonely
items.note: Leave the arrangement almost empty.

items.name: Playful
items.note: Let one part behave badly.

items.name: Hypnotic
items.note: Repeat past the point of comfort.

items.name: Gritty
items.note: Distort the sample, not the master.

items.name: Ethereal
items.note: Reverb as an instrument, not an effect.

items.name: Tense
items.note: Withhold resolution the whole time.

items.name: Romantic
items.note: Rich chords, close mics, slow phrasing.

items.name: Drowsy
items.note: Drag the swing. Soften every attack.

items.name: Menacing
items.note: Low, slow, and mostly silence.

items.name: Bittersweet
items.note: Major melody over a minor bass.

items.name: Futuristic
items.note: Synthetic textures, no acoustic reference.

items.name: Sacred
items.note: Choir, organ, room. Nothing modern.

items.name: Restless
items.note: Never let a bar repeat identically.

items.name: Smoky
items.note: Late-night dynamics. Play behind the beat.

items.name: Glacial
items.note: Huge, slow, and almost still.
